Interface Display

All Known Implementing Classes:
GroveOledSsd1315, NativeDisplay
public interface Display
A board display with RGB565 colors, basic drawing operations and text output. Implementations are supplied by a board facade such as M5StackCardputer.getDisplay() so application code can receive a mock in unit tests.
